title: Retro Session-Layer section prints a table of zeros when its instrument has never recorded anything
summary: session_layer_report renders 'Instrument not running' for never-recorded families, an active note for out-of-period ones, and an all-unresolved role line.

title: Own-branch force-push and gh pr create still prompt, because the static permission lists contradict the owner's own-branch rule
summary: settings.json allows gh pr create and no longer asks for force-push; guard test pins force-push to the default branch as ask.

title: Live role sessions run with stale or no project hooks, so the session guard, manual-action sampler and session_role stamping never fire
summary: Freshness check, launcher preflight (--allow-stale), launch-rule guide and M7 clock re-baselined; live probe left as the owner's step.

title: About 43% of hand closures have no tools.jsonl shard, which caps derived time and cost coverage
summary: Cause split from 116 sessions: mostly launched outside the repo (handed to the live-sessions ticket); cwd-relative hook commands fixed with a top-level resolve plus cd.
